widgets.title: Volume diário de ordens de serviço

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE Evento = 'os_criada' FACET dateOf(timestamp) SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT average(DuracaoExecucaoSegundos)/60 AS 'min' FROM Log WHERE Evento = 'os_status_alterado' AND StatusNovo = 'Finalizada' SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE Evento = 'os_status_alterado' FACET StatusNovo SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT percentile(duration, 50, 95, 99) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'oficina-mecanica-api' TIMESERIES
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE Evento = 'os_falha_processamento' TIMESERIES SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT average(cpuUsedCores), average(memoryWorkingSetBytes) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName LIKE 'oficina-%' FACET podName TIMESERIES
